notes: m7G-MaP-seq. NaBH4 is applied to purified RNA, not to cells, so treatment is none for all; NaBH4-reduced libraries are a modification-mapping chemistry (assay_class other), mock-treated libraries kept as total_rnaseq. 'total RNA' libraries are not rRNA-depleted (mostly rRNA); 'mRNA' libraries: enrichment method not stated, rrna_removal left out. Medium, phase, temperature not given. WT re-read: Unmodified BW25113 WT -> wild_type.

strain_group.q: RNA from E. coli (strain BW25113 and RsmG KO)

treatment.q: The RNA was treated with NaBH4 or mock-treated, then reverse transcribed.

inducer_added.q: The RNA was treated with NaBH4 or mock-treated, then reverse transcribed.

transcription_arrested.q: The RNA was treated with NaBH4 or mock-treated, then reverse transcribed.

mixed_organism.q: RNA from E. coli (strain BW25113 and RsmG KO)

assay_class.q: Libraries were prepared from total RNA.
m7G modified positions are converted to abasic sites by mild reduction, recorded as cDNA mutations through reverse transcription
